name: Mosaic of the Strange
detailed_description:
🧩 Mosaic of the Strange is digital cross-stitch. A meditative game about completing a single enormous grid puzzle that reveals a mystifying collage of paranormal events.

🖼️ Solve regions to gradually uncover chilling pixel art depictions of mysterious events, incredible people and strange creatures that defy our conventional view of the world.

💣 If you know how to play Minesweeper, you already know how to play a Mega Mosaic! The numbered clues (0-9) indicate how many light tiles must be placed within 1 square of the clue.

🎶 Whether you're engrossed in your favourite podcasts or listening to your favourite tunes, Mosaic of the Strange serves as the perfect backdrop to enhance your experience. Or enjoy  the built-in soundtrack that oozes mystery and dread.

⏳ Dozens of Hours of Addictive Gameplay: Lose yourself in hours of bewitching puzzle-solving as you explore the world of the paranormal.
